related.title: Ethernet IPv4：短封包填補與長度欄位
related.titleEn: Ethernet IPv4: short-frame padding and length fields
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：未到期租約不因一次續租逾時失效；有明示選項時重算而非套預設比例。 交接時須能核對：交付 lease-events.csv、兩種租約時間軸與伺服器覆寫反例。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: A lease does not expire after one renewal timeout; recompute explicit options instead of using defaults. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver lease-events.csv, both lease timelines and a server-override counterexample.
related.difference: 逐位元組標記IP表頭、IP資料及Ethernet填補，不將填補解碼為應用資料。
related.differenceEn: Label IP header, IP data and Ethernet padding byte by byte without decoding padding as application data.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
DHCP租約具有續租與重新繫結階段；伺服器可明示T1/T2，不能總是假定預設比例。
教學基準：3600*0.875-3600*0.5 = 1350 s；對照：7200*0.875-7200*0.5 = 2700 s。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

乙太資料欄位的填補不屬於IP總長；接收端以IP表頭長度識別有效資料。
教學基準：max(0,46-28) = 18 B；對照：max(0,46-40) = 6 B。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
DHCP leases have renewal and rebinding phases; servers can supply T1/T2, so default ratios are not universal.
Teaching baseline: 3600*0.875-3600*0.5 = 1350 s; comparison: 7200*0.875-7200*0.5 = 2700 s. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

Ethernet padding is outside the IP total length; the receiver uses the IP length to identify valid bytes.
Teaching baseline: max(0,46-28) = 18 B; comparison: max(0,46-40) = 6 B. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.difference: 建立MAC、Ethernet Tag、來源PE、sequence、arrival表，以sequence排序而非到達順序。
related.differenceEn: Record MAC, Ethernet Tag, source PE, sequence and arrival; order updates by sequence rather than arrival.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。

EVPN的MAC移動序號協助選擇更新位置；接收時間較晚不保證通告較新。
教學基準：120/30 = 4 s；對照：120/60 = 2 s。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
